Name: Area Clear Hotkey
Author: OArtu5
Description:
[b]What this mod does[/b]
Area Clear Hotkey lets you clear a huge area around your player with a single hotkey while still preserving normal drops and skill XP.
This mod is made for players who want:
- fast cleanup of trees, rocks, stumps, logs, boulders, and twigs,
- skill XP from normal tool logic,
- separate toggles for each type of target,
- simple in-game configuration through Generic Mod Config Menu,
- an optional Shaving Enchantment toggle,
- and a powerful cleanup tool without any energy cost.

[b]Important:[/b]
This mod simulates normal axe and pickaxe hits so the game still handles drops and relevant XP through its regular systems.

[b]Features[/b]
- Hotkey-based area clearing.
- Configurable radius up to 200 tiles.
- Includes an enable/disable toggle.
- Organized GMCM categories for easier setup.
- Optional `Apply Shaving Enchantment` toggle.
- Separate toggles for:
- Chopping down Trees
- Chopping down Fruit Trees
- Removing the Tree Stump
- Chopping down Twigs
- Chopping down Large Stump
- Chopping down Large Log
- Break Rocks
- Break Boulders
- Supports in-game configuration through GMCM.

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download the mod.
2. Extract the `AreaClearHotkey` folder into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
